remarks: Located in the heart of SoNo! 1 BR unit is on the 2nd floor. This newly renovated 1 BR apartment is a perfect blend of modern luxury and urban convenience. With extra-height ceilings that create an airy and spacious feel, The layout is designed for both comfort and style, perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Living room features exposed brick and amazing views of the downtown. Unit gets great natural light and has central A/C with a stacked W/D. Security video to get in at front door of building. Minutes away from Metro North Train Station, beaches, parks, SoNo Mall, restaurants, shopping, and much more. One parking spot included in the Haviland St Parking Garage with the rental!!!
